integrity: The proof first shows structurally that every vertex cover of the lollipop is an edge metric generator, using zero-coordinate sets and the independent complement of a cover. The dimension and basis count then reduce exactly to minimum vertex covers of the clique-plus-path structure. A standalone checker enumerates all subsets and recomputes edge-distance vectors directly.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the standard lollipop K_m joined by one bridge to P_ell, with m at least three and ell at least two.
No extension to arbitrary block graphs or arbitrary clique-path coalescences is claimed.
Finite exhaustive verification over 3 <= m <= 7 and 2 <= ell <= 9 is corroborative only.
A differently named or non-indexed treatment of the same family may exist.

The first-public date uses the earliest exact public timestamp located for an author-uploaded full text; the journal PDF itself lists received, revised, and accepted dates but no explicit online-publication day.
title: Dominant edge metric bases of lollipop graphs
